build_seq2slate_transformer_model: build a Seq2SlateTransformerModel to rank candidate feeds for a user using encoder-decoder Transformer
create_seq2slate_transformer_net: create a Seq2SlateTransformerNet dataclass to configure and instantiate a Transformer-based Seq2Slate ranking model
run_seq2slate_rank_mode: run the Seq2SlateTransformerModel in rank mode to decode and return an ordered list of candidate indices
test_seq2slate_log_probs: test the Seq2SlateTransformerModel in per_seq_log_probs mode to compute generative log probabilities for REINFORCE training
review_generator_candidate_decoding: review the Generator class to understand greedy and sampling-based one-step candidate decoding from probability distributions
